subject: Deal-driven capacity handoff: OEM ETA, cloud bridge, and sizing checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmeai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request + rough timeline (ACME deal)

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock in dedicated capacity sizing for the ACME production rollout tied to the commercial terms (ACME-2028-07). Short summary: initial prod needs ~40 GPUs for inference (burst to 60 for ramp windows). Contract target start is Nov 1.

Can you confirm:
- OEM lead time assumptions you would plan on for dedicated hardware (we need a pragmatic ETA to include in our internal launch plan)
- Whether Redwood can bridge initial weeks with cloud capacity (we may need a 6–12 week bridge)
- Any sizing template or checklist you need us to complete to finalize quantities and SKUs

Attached: SOW_ACME_v1.pdf (high-level scope).

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful — Sarah

--
Sarah Cole
Head of Platform, Acme AI
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Ops <cloudops@cleardata.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request + rough timeline (ACME deal)

Sarah —

Thanks, and congrats on getting the scope stable. I'm looping in the small ops + procurement core so we can convert the ask into an actionable handoff. Quick plan and required inputs below.

What Redwood will do now:
- Run sizing validation and present two pragmatic configs (conservative onramp + steady-state) by Monday 9/4. (owner: Karthik)
- Request OEM quote and lead-time confirmation for preferred SKUs (owner: Naomi)
- Stand up a cloud-bridge proposal (clear timeline and cost) for the first 8–12 weeks while HW ships (owner: Ben, CloudBridge Ops)
- Draft the capacity rollout timeline for signatures and PO triggers (owner: Marissa)

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm whether burst above 60 GPUs is allowed (temporary overprovision) or must be strictly constrained.
- Complete the attached capacity_sizing_template.xlsx with peak/avg token rates and per-model latencies (helps us recommend batching/quantization tradeoffs).

Risks & assumptions (prelim):
- If OEM lead time exceeds 10 weeks, we'll prioritize a cloud-bridge for launch and stage hardware delivery in two tranches.
- Customs and freight can add 2–3 weeks on longer lead-time SKUs — we need clarity on destination and import class.

Please see the attached templates: capacity_sizing_template.xlsx and a draft deal_rollout_timeline.md. Ben — can you confirm if CloudBridge Ops can reserve a soft-block for early-September (8-week window) at quoted rates?

I'll put a quick decision checklist in the shared drive and tag owners.

Thanks — Evelyn
Director, Dedicated Capacity Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): capacity_sizing_template.xlsx; deal_rollout_timeline.md
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Sep 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request + rough timeline (ACME deal)

Evelyn / Sarah —

I ran a quick runbook against the template Sarah attached. Two recommended options that balance cost, latency, and lead-time risk:

Option A (cloud-forward ramp + smaller HW onramp):
- Bridge: Reserved cloud pool (8 weeks) sized to 60 GPUs equiv for peak windows; burst managed with autoscale.
- Dedicated HW: Ship 32xA100 (40GB) in tranche 1, add 8 H100 (80GB) in tranche 2 for peak workloads.
- Pros: faster initial delivery, lower upfront HW spend, simpler customs profile.
- Cons: slightly higher unit cost while cloud bridge active.

Option B (heavy-dedicated commit):
- Dedicated HW: 40xH100 (80GB) ordered up front.
- Pros: better long-term unit economics, simpler infra.
- Cons: OEM lead-time risk, higher capital commitment, potential 10–14 week ETA.

My read: given your Nov 1 target, Option A plus an expedited OEM rush for H100 is the least-risk path. If Acme signs PO by 9/10 we can lock an OEM slot with a rush clause that targets an 8–10 week lead time.

Note for procurement: Naomi, we should ask OEM for two quotes: standard lead-time and rush (paid) with explicit ship-by windows and penalty/holdback language if they miss the guaranteed ship date. Also request CIF incoterms for clarity on freight.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2028-07

-Karthik
Senior Program Manager, Capacity Planning

Thanks for looping us in. Attached is a preliminary OEM quote for the H100 configuration (NVIDIA_quote_20280902.pdf). Current visibility:
- Standard fulfillment for H100 series to our channel partners: ~10–12 weeks from PO receipt.
- We can provide an expedited lane (rush) at a premium that targets ~7–8 weeks, subject to manufacturing window availability.

Team / Sarah —

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Synthesis and next steps below (decisions captured so we have a single source of truth):

Executive decision (Acme confirmed): proceed with an initial cloud-bridge while we secure a rushed OEM lane.

Operational plan (owners & deadlines):
- Ben: Lock a soft-reserved cloud-block for 8 weeks to cover Nov 1 launch. Confirm pricing and reservation by EOD 9/6. (Ben/CloudBridge Ops)
- Naomi: Request a revised OEM quote that includes: standard lead-time, rush lane pricing (7–8 week target), explicit ship-by SLA, and CIF incoterm. Please request penalty/credit language for missed ship dates. Deliver by 9/6. (Naomi)
- Karthik: Finalize tranche plan (A: 32xA100 + tranche H100; B: full 40xH100) and recommend the tranche trigger conditions (traffic thresholds). Deliver updated sizing doc 9/6. (Karthik)
- Marissa: Update the deal timeline and PO triggers in the HubSpot record; coordinate commercial language around rush deposit and acceptance criteria. Deliver draft redlines by 9/7. (Marissa)
- Sarah / Acme: Confirm burst policy (can briefly go >60 GPUs) by COB 9/6 and send completed capacity_sizing_template.xlsx.

Fallbacks & contingencies:
- If OEM cannot commit to rush or lead time >12 weeks, we will extend the cloud-bridge to 12 weeks and stage hardware in two tranches with priority shipping for the most latency-sensitive models.
- If customs/freight risk is elevated, Naomi to propose alternative ports or express freight with cost estimate.

Attachments referenced: NVIDIA_quote_20280902.pdf (OEM quote), capacity_sizing_template.xlsx, deal_rollout_timeline.md, SOW_ACME_v1.pdf.

I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call on Thu 9/7 to confirm the final sign-off checklist.

Thanks — Evelyn
